# Verification Record

- Scope: focused / consumer-import / adjacent / all-blocking
- Status: passed / failed / not_run / environment_blocked / excluded
- Tested SHA and tree/dirty state:
- Baseline SHA and comparable environment:
- Command and working directory:
- OS, runtime and dependency versions:
- Start/end time, exit code:
- Total, failures, errors, skipped/excluded (or unknown with reason):
- Failure IDs, new/resolved failures:
- Root causes and affected/unassessed suites:
- Exclusions and human disposition:
- Evidence location tied to tested SHA:
- Consumer inventory, before/after imports, private symbols, dynamic-loading limits:
- Acceptance clause → change → test mapping:
- Assertion/fixture/exclusion/behavior changes and disposition:
- Structure exceedances, responsibility split or rationale/owner/deadline/exception:
- Review routing evidence, availability and budget gaps:
- Full Green established: yes / no (focused success never implies yes)
